verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail's own marketing says it offers APIs that connect the virtual mailbox to other tools and keep documents and mail in sync. That is a real first-party API, but nothing shows it matches the UI's full feature set. missing for 10: API reference documentation, evidence that UI actions (check deposit, forwarding, shredding, junk filtering, AI labels, multi-user access) are exposed via API, a stated API/UI parity commitment, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
